description: This file contains comprehensive unit tests for the PooledBufferStream class, verifying constructors, properties, methods, buffer management, and sequence handling. It ensures correct behavior in various scenarios, including multi-segment buffer chains and resource pooling.

classes.name: PooledBufferStream
classes.description: A custom stream class that utilizes pooling for buffer management, supporting reading, writing, seeking, resetting, and sequence Rent/Return operations, optimized for high-performance scenarios.

classes.name: PooledBufferStream.BufferSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of buffer used internally by PooledBufferStream, includes pooling logic for efficient reuse, and supports linked segment chains for multi-segment buffers.

classes.name: DummyReadOnlySequenceSegment
classes.description: A mock segment used in tests to simulate non-BufferSegment objects returned from the sequence chain.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets the Memory and RunningIndex properties, initializing the segment with the provided data and index.

methods.name: SetNext
methods.description: Assigns the Next segment in the chain.
